# KhonsuGraph

> Built for Hunters. Open-source, local-first graph investigation workbench on HawDB. Cypher, SQL, a graph canvas, data-source plugins and reviewable .dash dashboards. Independent of HawDB. Apache-2.0.

- [English overview](https://khonsugraph.com/index.md)
- [中文介绍](https://khonsugraph.com/zh/index.md)
- [Documentation](https://khonsugraph.com/docs/llms-full.txt)
- [中文文档](https://khonsugraph.com/docs/zh/llms-full.txt)
- [Source](https://github.com/JetSquirrel/KhonsuGraph)
